lines.text: Priya wanted a spring trip to the Smokies.
Three nights later, she had twenty browser tabs open and still no plan.
Here's the fix. Start with one plan.
Our Smokies Trip Pack has three, five and seven-day itineraries,
the seasons and road openings, where to stay,
and ten day hikes as G P X files for your phone, numbered to match the plan.
lines.show: and ten day hikes as GPX ~ ~ files for your phone, numbered to match the plan.

lines.text: Priya picked her first trail in ten minutes.
Save this before you plan your trip.
